supported.boundaries: Attached ㄹ after vowel/ㄹ stems, 을 after other consonants; existing ㄷ/ㅂ/ㅅ and other irregular recovery remains available.

supported.excluded: Recovered modal/retrospective stacks, wrong allomorph paths, direct adnominal 을 plus restrictive particle 밖에, and final ending followed by topic 는.
supported.dictionary: Both filters retain attested lexical heads; no new lexical-class restriction. 되돌려받다 has no pinned primary headword: retained raw with unknown dictionary evidence, removed by both filters.
